newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money steady between 3.00-3.05 pct.
newsitem.headline: German call money steady between 3.00-3.05 pct.

text.p: German call money rates were steady on Monday at around 3.00 to 3.05 percent with an early surge in demand being quickly meet by fresh offers, money traders said.
Traders said they expect the rate to remain around current levels this week with the Bundesbank willing to keep bank liquidity even.
Banks held 38.6 billion marks with the Bundesbank on Friday, down slightly from 38.9 billion marks the day before, pushing the monthly average to 40.1 billion marks.
